title: Gauss-Newton Natural Gradient Descent for Shape Learning
summary: We explore the use of the Gauss-Newton method for optimization in shape learning, including implicit neural surfaces and geometry-informed neural networks. The method addresses key challenges in shape learning, such as the ill-conditioning of the underlying differential constraints and the mismatch between the optimization problem in parameter space and the function space where the problem is naturally posed.
